messages:
Aisha (CEO): Leaving a short follow-up thread from today's all-hands for the strategy questions we didn't finish. Post quick clarifications here and I'll respond.
Priya (sales): Thanks! First: what's the one-sentence competitive positioning we should use on discovery calls?
Aisha (CEO): One-sentence: "Redwood turns LLMs into a reliable production service—predictable latency, transparent unit economics, and flexible deployment modes for real-world SLAs." Keep it conversational.
Leah (solutions): Can we get one concrete customer story to use in demos that highlights Dedicated vs hosted?
Tom (VP Product): Use the mid-market analytics customer: moved from managed endpoints to Dedicated, saw 2.8x reduction in per-token cost and cut 99th-pctl tail latency by ~60ms. We'll anonymize details and put the case study in sales collateral.
Ravi (eng): Roadmap Q: are we prioritizing kernel-level attention optimizations or system-level features like multi-tenant routing?
Aisha (CEO): Both matter, but prioritize kernel/quant improvements for the top model families first; system-level routing and multi-tenant feature work follows once we hit stable perf targets.
Jules (research): On model catalog policy: do we require community licenses compatibility (e.g., permissive licenses) for hosted offering?
Tom (VP Product): Yes. For hosted we prefer models with compatible licenses; for Dedicated/Private, customers can bring their own models but we still validate safety and compatibility. Policy doc is getting updated.
Priya (sales): Competitor messaging: if a customer says "we can just use X cloud with GPUs" what are the top 3 quick rebuttals?
Aisha (CEO): 1) Engineering overhead: integrations, KV cache, and ops. 2) Predictability: latency + cost SLOs. 3) Product-level controls: rollouts, routing/fallbacks, and quality monitoring tied to evals. Short, factual.
Leah (solutions): Any standard SLO numbers we can quote in docs?
Tom (VP Product): Use these templates: `99th pct latency < 150ms` (for Dedicated-XL with typical gen), and `availability >= 99.9%` for Dedicated customers under SLA. Replace with measured numbers for demos.
record-bot: Slides + recording uploaded: https://internal.redwood.example/all-hands/1761237890 :white_check_mark:
Priya (sales): Perfect. Will wait for the anonymized case study and battlecard.
Aisha (CEO): We'll ship the battlecard and SLO one-pager by EOD. Thanks everyone. Closing thread. — Aisha
